EN: Free Captains are the charismatic lords of pirate <<m:{GLOBAL.DwellingConcept.Hyperlink}>>, where the most infamous sailors band together to terrorize the seas.[br/][bulletlist][bullet/]Up to {IntMaxDwellings} Free Captains exist on a realm.[bullet/]Free Captains have different personalities: [personalityPirateAvaricious/] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PirateDwellingAvariciousPirateConcept]Avaricious[/hyperlink], [personalityPirateBloodthirsty/] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PirateDwellingBloodthirstyPirateConcept]Bloodthirsty[/hyperlink], or [personalityPirateHeroic/] [hyperlink,GLOBAL.PirateDwellingHeroicPirateConcept]Heroic[/hyperlink].[bullet/]Bonds with Free Captains are achieved by fulfilling their Demands or doing their Quests.[bullet/]Having a Bond with a Free Captain will unlock several trading options with them, such as {GLOBAL.TomeConcept.Hyperlink} content, pirate <<m:{GLOBAL.UnitConcept.Hyperlink}>> and <<m:{GLOBAL.SpellConcept.Hyperlink} >>, or {GLOBAL.EquipmentConcept.Hyperlink}.[bullet/]Free Captains send out <<m:{GLOBAL.PirateRaidConcept.Hyperlink}>> while at {GLOBAL.PirateDwellingWarConcept.Hyperlink} or when another {GLOBAL.EmpireConcept.Hyperlink} pays them to attack—even their allies.[bullet/]Once Captured, the {GLOBAL.DwellingConcept.Hyperlink} of a Free Captain is immediately destroyed and awards some of the Dwelling's treasures and trade items to the conqueror.[/bulletlist]
